purpose: Offline H01 fixture provenance only; not current market data, a user position, or a forecast.

source.name: Yahoo Finance public chart response
source.access: public read-only endpoint; no account, credential, query key, or live write used
source.raw_response_retention: The source response was read through the permitted public extractor. This sanitized artifact retains only the fields used by the fixture; it does not claim a provider byte-for-byte response digest.

normalization.daily_timestamp: The provider daily response timestamp is preserved as the UTC start instant; session_date remains the daily identity.
normalization.adjustment_basis: raw provider OHLCV. The provider adjusted-close field is intentionally not copied into this raw OHLC fixture, preventing an adjusted-close-only candle presentation.
